# HORN-Z1 — Chinese Room

This note executes the canonical `maps/chinese-room-slice.horn.json` artifact through the native `%horn` interpreter. HORN owns meaning and authored geometry; Zeppelin owns interaction and execution.

paragraphs.title: Authority boundary
paragraphs.text:
%md
## Authority boundary

The `%horn` interpreter is deliberately thin. Presentation views use the TypeScript adapter; headless validation, query, explanation, impact, diff, and inspection use the pinned Celix-discovered libhorn services. The network remains a lossy semantic/debug projection; authored geometry and route authority remain only in the canonical HORN document.
